method.method_draft: Scan the image left to right and list every heavy-atom connection: R-C, C=O, C-N, N-N, and N≡N. Do not count the curved arrow or the +/− charge marks. Count the five listed non-hydrogen bonds to obtain the total.

再推理：按指定方法只数非氢重原子之间的连接，依次为 R-C、C=O、C-N、N-N、N≡N，共 5 个；不计入弯箭头或电荷符号。
